== frame after_tab cursor=0,29
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd mydir/
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
== frame after_pwd cursor=4,26
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd mydir/
|testuser@<HOST> ~/mydir $ pwd
|<HOME>/mydir
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~/mydir $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@1 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/mydir
@1 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 pwd
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/mydir
